_meta.purpose: Every phone number and legal line the app could show. Nothing here renders in a production build until someone has checked it against an official source and set verified to true.
_meta.rule: Only Abdelrahman flips a flag, after reading the official source. Until then the Shield screen shows the card, the name and a 'pending verification' line — never an invented number, and never a tel: link.
_meta.origin: The numbers came from the v1 app and were never confirmed. On 16 Sep 2026 Abdelrahman supplied a replacement set; two of the three differed from what was here, and one old entry named the wrong organisation. Each row's note says what was corroborated and what was not. All three are still unverified.

contacts.note: Abdelrahman's table, 16 Sep. psd.gov.jo describes 911 as Jordan's unified emergency number, which is the one entry of the three I could corroborate. Check it on psd.gov.jo yourself before flipping this: https://www.psd.gov.jo/en-us/content/security-services/911-emergency-number/

Abdelrahman's table, 16 Sep. I could NOT corroborate this number from an official source — treat it as the least checked of the three. It replaces 110, which this file had wrong: 110 is the Jordan River Foundation's families-and-children helpline, a charity line, not the PSD directorate this row names. Check against psd.gov.jo or moi.gov.jo's directory.

Abdelrahman's table, 16 Sep. Corroborated: published sources give 196 with extensions 812594 and 812232, and a direct line 06 563 3404. It replaces +962 6 465 5660, which this file carried from v1 and which matches none of those. Confirm on the unit's own page at psd.gov.jo before flipping. NOTE the shape: a caller dials 196 and then the extension — if the Shield screen ever renders this as one tel: link it will dial 196812594, which is not a number. That is why this row carries extensions separately.

text.en: Cybercrime Law No. 17 of 2023 protects you.
text.ar: قانون الجرائم الإلكترونية رقم 17 لسنة 2023 يحميك.

legal.note: A statement about the law. It needs the official text and the article cited before it renders.

links.note: The official reporting form the reference build linked to. A URL the app sends someone to is the same kind of claim as a phone number: it renders only once somebody has opened it and confirmed it is the right form and still live.
